values.note: 87 electric/water RV or tent sites with gravel pads: Lakeside 19 (RVs to 40 ft), White Oak 31 (to 40 ft, reached over a narrow low-water bridge that can flood), Whispering Pines 23 (to 50 ft) and the Beaver Dam equestrian campground 14 (to 40 ft, four pull-throughs). Two vehicles per site besides the camping unit.

sites.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/douthat ('Total sites of each type : EW Lakeside, 19;EW Beaver Dam Horse, 14; EW White Oak, 31; EW Whispering Pines, 23', 'Maximum RV length is 50 feet', 'Total sites : 87'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Each campground has a bathhouse with showers and a dump station. No cell service in the park; Wi-Fi near the bathhouse and at the park office, camp store and beach complex. Firewood for sale; fishing licenses at the camp store. Generators may not be used in any campground.

facilities.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/douthat ('The campground has a bath house with showers and a dump station', 'Free Wi-Fi is available near the bathhouse', 'Licenses and permits are available at the camp store', 'Generators may not be used in any campgrounds'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Only Whispering Pines is open year-round; from November through March water is unavailable at individual campsites.

season.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/douthat ('Camping is available year-round in Whispering Pines campground. (Note: From November through March water is unavailable at individual campsites because of freezing weather.)'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'Reservations are site-specific in all campgrounds.' Late arrivals at Lakeside, White Oak and Beaver Dam collect a named envelope at the park office kiosk; Whispering Pines campers go straight to the camp host.

summary: Confirmed reservable (site-specific) and year-round camping (Whispering Pines only, no site water November-March). Added 50-amp electric with water, no sewer, 87 sites to 50 ft, showers/dump/camp store/Wi-Fi near the bathhouse. Fees left as human-checked 2026-10-12 (the booking site's per-site details could not be read: its API answered 403 after an earlier batch). Not stated on the park page: booking window, cutoff or max stay (left inherited).
